title: Chiropractor Google Ads Management | Grow Your Practice with RevKey — RevKey

facts.fact: RevKey states that it will not ask clients to sign a long-term contract.
facts.quote: We will not ever ask you to sign a long term contract.

facts.fact: RevKey says it offers a 30 Day Satisfaction Guarantee with its Google Ads management services.
facts.quote: we offer a [**30 Day Satisfaction Guarantee**](https://www.revkey.com/google-ads-management-pricing) with our services.

facts.fact: RevKey says other agencies often lock clients into contracts ranging from 6 months to 2 years; this is RevKey's characterization of competitors, not a verified industry figure.
facts.quote: Many agencies will try to lock you into using their services with contracts that range from 6 months to 2 years.

facts.fact: RevKey says it will be upfront about its pricing and the budget required to reach the right customers, and points to a separate Pricing page, but the page itself gives no dollar amounts.
facts.quote: We will be up front with our pricing and how much of a budget it will take to reach the right customers.
